---
format:
  typst:
    papersize: a4
    margin:
      x: 1in
      y: 1in
    page-numbering: "1"
    toc: false
    number-sections: false
    mainfont: "DejaVu Sans"
    fontsize: 11pt
    pdf-standard: ua-1
    include-in-header: 
      text: |
        #let bgcolor = rgb(60, 60, 60)
        #let textcolor = rgb(209, 213, 219)
        #let headingcolor = rgb(229, 231, 235)
        #let linkblue = rgb(96, 165, 250)

        #set page(fill: bgcolor)
        #set text(fill: textcolor)
        #show heading: set text(fill: headingcolor)
        #show link: set text(fill: linkblue)
title-block-style: none
---
